causality.name: Gerhana → ritual Indonesia
causality.finding: No direct causal evidence; many rituals follow their own calendars.

causality.name: Chit Ngiat Pan → karhutla Bangka
causality.finding: Temporal overlap exists, but fires were already reported around/before the ritual period and human/dry conditions are stronger explanations.

causality.name: Chiong Si Ku → karhutla Mempawah
causality.finding: Fire risk and hotspots were already present; no mechanism linking ritual to fire was found.

causality.name: Ritual → gempa Flores
causality.finding: BMKG identifies Flores Back-Arc Thrust and aftershock sequence as the mechanism.

causality.name: Ritual → banjir
causality.finding: Flood reports have hydrometeorological explanations; no ritual mechanism established.

causality.name: Mythos → ritual behavior
causality.finding: Sources frequently explain rituals through the associated belief or traditional narrative.

causality.name: Media → mythos propagation
causality.finding: News, video, podcasts, calendars and cultural coverage repeatedly reproduce narratives.
